subject: Running app from computer without R

messages.author: d2ad3cb3b7de95a5
messages.subject: Running app from computer without R
parts: If the Shiny web app created is being called by another web application, would it be able to run even on a computer that does not have R Studio or anything downloaded?

messages.author: fd2fc7e46319d1dd
messages.subject: Re: Running app from computer without R
parts:
Hi,

In order to run a shiny app, you definitely need a Shiny Server. 
RStudio is not needed but you need a Shiny Server and R.

You can install a Shiny Server on a server by yourself (https://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/shiny-server/) or use a built-in solution offered by RStudio to deploy your app (http://www.shinyapps.io/). After this step, you will have a web adress for your shiny app and you will be able to use it to call your shiny app in another web application.

HTH ! :)

Best regards.
